Centre for Effective Altruism

Policy Researcher

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) is seeking a Policy Researcher to help shape our policy engagement strategy.

About CEA

CEA helps build and support the effective altruism community. We run key programs including EA Global conferences, the EA Forum, and community building grants.

The Role

As a Policy Researcher, you will:

  • Research policy areas relevant to EA priorities (AI governance, biosecurity, global development)
  • Produce policy briefs and recommendations for stakeholders
  • Engage with policymakers and government officials
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in public policy, political science, or related field
  • 3+ years of policy research or government experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Deep familiarity with at least one EA cause area

Location & Compensation

This role is based in Oxford, UK or remote within compatible time zones. Salary: £55,000 - £75,000 depending on experience and location.
